actualProblem: Maintainers need an accurate, comprehensive census of compiled agentic-workflow structure, capabilities and permission patterns. The stale package-dependency frontmatter is not the executed goal.
scope: Every immediate .github/workflows/*.lock.yml file at each independently proven protected checkout; no sampling.

sourceReview.finding: Daily/manual full-population statistics; source mandates v4 cached Python, safe_load, engine metadata, agent-job and all-job permissions, deduplicated JSON safe outputs, discussion-category completeness and manifest-first MCP extraction.
Imports discussion safe outputs, reporting guidance and OTLP. It does not define an independent accuracy checker.
One audits Discussion, title prefix, one-day expiry and close-older behavior explain why published output history is not a durable historical evidence interface.
Reporting structure and run links support discovery, not numeric verification or immutable creation proof.
Telemetry endpoints are configuration. Their declaration establishes neither retained token receipts nor compliance with the turn/token contract.

The protected agent job checks out the repository, uploads cache-memory including history, and separately uploads selected agent files. The agent artifact does not promise the statistics-summary file; the protected cache artifact can preserve the original same-day summary. Exact checkout SHA readback and upload receipts are required.
Read as untrusted implementation evidence only; never executed. The independent oracle is a separately authored, pinned PyYAML native census.

sourceEras.meaning: Actual addition against its real parent. Original body already required all lockfiles, accurate statistics, audits publication and retained history. The phenomenon could exist through manual analysis before installation.
Single-script cached analysis and explicit resource budgets. Do not backdate these mechanics into the original source.
Missing-PyYAML guard fixed silent empty safe-output statistics.
Metadata engine extraction and effective agent-job permissions replace invalid frontmatter assumptions.
V4 discussion-category extraction and loud completeness checks. This is the earliest compatible body for this frozen reconciliation.
Runtime frontmatter changes only; the V4 measurement body is unchanged. Exact actual compiled checkout/upload behavior is still checked for each accepted execution.

measureDisposition.candidate: Independently reconciled persisted native statistical assertions
measureDisposition.reason: Accurate full-population repository statistics are a direct source-defined outcome facet. Count facts only after independent input replay, never because a report says its own statistics are correct.

measureDisposition.candidate: Mapped statistical assertions that disagree with independent native facts
measureDisposition.reason: Keep inaccuracies separate so greater output breadth cannot hide contradictory or wrong statistics.

measureDisposition.candidate: Complete source-family coverage, unresolved categories, parser availability and compact-summary limit
measureDisposition.reason: These describe report completeness/reliability; native partial factual improvement does not imply complete goal acceptance.

measureDisposition.candidate: Five bash turns, one-million input/output tokens and cached script reuse
measureDisposition.reason: Need original complete execution/usage receipts. They cannot be inferred from statistics or successful jobs.
An older cache date is not exact historical input identity; numeric agreement does not prove insight quality, useful recommendations or downstream decisions.

measureDisposition.candidate: Published Discussion count, successful runs, or agent self-assessment
measureDisposition.reason: Publication and execution are not statistically accurate coverage. Edited surviving Discussions are discovery, not immutable historical numeric evidence.

measureDisposition.candidate: Dependency vulnerability backlog and package freshness
measureDisposition.reason: The frontmatter is stale. The workflow analyzes compiled Actions YAML, not package-manager lockfiles or dependency-remediation outcomes.

measureDisposition.candidate: Full native repository counts computed today at baseline
measureDisposition.reason: Git reconstructs all census inputs, demonstrating that the native population pre-existed; a new replay cannot prove that an accurate census was historically delivered before adoption.

canonicalDataDisposition: Canonical activity can identify runs but does not contain complete immutable compiled lockfile bytes, the original cached numeric summary or protected checkout/upload logs. This outcome therefore uses bounded retained Actions evidence plus immutable Git inputs, not a reconstructed dashboard-side query.
limitations: Attainment-only is an evidence limitation, not a claim that accurate statistics were invented at workflow adoption.
Missing source/report binding, unacquired retained receipts and incompatible historical source eras remain null.
Native fact delivery is a partial source-goal facet; the final Discussion, insights, budgets, costs and sole attribution remain separately unmeasured.
Retain changing file populations and assertion inventories. A count change alone cannot establish quality improvement, a sustained trend or causal benefit.
